query: SELECT service_name, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, start_timestamp, end_timestamp, span_name, attributes->>'gen_ai.agent.name' AS agent, attributes->>'gen_ai.request.model' AS model, attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens' AS input_tokens, attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.output_tokens' AS output_tokens FROM records WHERE service_name IN ('vis-transfer24-baseline','vis-transfer24-candidate') AND span_name LIKE 'chat %' AND end_timestamp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY start_timestamp LIMIT 1000
